messages:
Jess H: Quick sync — planning a 2-week micro-refguide sprint + 30-min webinar to launch 3 tiny refapps for OSS starters. Want copy + bench narrative + inbound routing. Thoughts?
Mike L: Love it. Target date?
Jess H: Aiming week of June 17. Short demos (5–8m each), bench highlights (latency/cost), 1 CTA per demo.
Anika R: Can we do a before/after bench: baseline hosted API vs dedicated quantized? Makes for clean numbers.
Taran P: We'll need 1 reproducible notebook per refapp + small docker image. Ops: what infra for live demo?
Leo C: For leads — route webinar signups to HubSpot -> lifecycle stage "refguide_webinar" + tag model_interest. Also add UTM params in CTA.
Ben S: Add a short eval checklist: seed prompts, target metrics (p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token), pass/fail thresholds.
Amanda V: I can draft launch post and webinar blurb. Will need sample outputs and 3 screenshots. Assign me assets?
Jess H: Assigning assets: @Taran P — demo infra; @Anika R — bench numbers & script; @Leo C — hubspot form + tags; @Ben S — eval checklist; @Amanda V — launch copy.
Taran P: Noted. Will push a minimal compose file and docker image to refguide-demo repo by Thurs.
Anika R: I'll share a small runbook and the bench script (bash + python) — snippet:
```bash
python bench.py --model redwood/fast-13b --seq 512 --warmup 50 --iters 200
```
Leo C: For inbound, let's add a thank-you email with 3 follow-ups: day0 (recording), day3 (how-to), day10 (case study + CTA). Tag and route to SDR queue if enterprise flag set.
Ben S: Put simple gating criteria for "engineering lead" in the form so SDRs get high-intent.
Amanda V: Draft will include 1 hero tweet, 1 launch blog, and 3 tutorial micro-posts. Can anyone supply short quote lines?
Jess H: I'll add: "Tiny refapps that make integrating inference predictable and cheap." — feel free to tweak.
deploy-bot: deployed landing page /marketing/refguide-lightning at 2024-06-05T17:22Z :white_check_mark:
Mike L: Timeline check — draft assets by Thu, rehearsals Fri, live Mon (June 17) — ok?
Anika R: OK from my side.
Taran P: OK.
Leo C: OK, will create HubSpot form today.
Ben S: Will finalize checklist by Wed.
Amanda V: Will share first draft by Wed EOD.
Jess H: Perfect. I'll run a quick kickoff tomorrow 11am — @everyone please try to be there. :rocket:
